name: favorites-manager
description: Manage reusable favorite prompts, capability combinations, execution locations, optional schedules, launches, and run history.
description_cn: 让 AI 创建、整理、定时运行并启动常用提示词与能力组合。

presentation.summary: 让 AI 帮你保存和启动常用工作模式，并按需附加定时计划。
examples: 每周一运行这个常用项
presentation.access_note: 会读写本机常用库；启动和删除操作需要确认。

workflow: List favorites first when the saved state is unclear.
Store prompt, skills, and execution location on the favorite itself.
Treat a schedule as an optional child of one favorite.
Request approval before launching or deleting.
